summary.result: The results provide valuable insights for urban planners, policy makers, and health professionals to enhance climate mitigation and adaptation strategies.
summary.background: With rising summer temperatures causing significant health hazards in urban areas, understanding temperatures is becoming increasingly important, and while IoT sensors can help to enhance the information provided by reference stations, there has been limited quantification of the extent and intensity of the additional high-temperature data that IoT sensors can provide.
